title: Licensed Station Engineer - London Heathrow
location: Abu Dhabi, ae | Abu Dhabi | ae | Abu Dhabi, , United Arab Emirates
description: We are expanding our Line Maintenance International (LMI) function and are looking for experienced LMI Engineers to be based at London Heathrow (LHR) . This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a world-class airline, providing front-line technical support and ensuring the highest standards of safety, compliance and operational performance across our international network. As we grow to more than 200 aircraft and 125+ destinations, you will be part of a global airline with the ambition, standards and opportunities to match your own. Why join us? Opportunity to work at London Heathrow, a key strategic station within our international network Exposure to a diverse and modern fleet Work alongside highly skilled aviation professionals Be part of a growing and dynamic international maintenance operation Competitive package and career development opportunities Your Role: The Station Engineer LMI is responsible for certifying and carrying out aircraft maintenance activities in compliance with all applicable standards and relevant approved technical data to optimize aircraft serviceability and support operational schedules. Safety & Quality: Ensures that aircraft effectivity is correctly established and that the latest revision of approved maintenance data is referenced prior to use. Performs maintenance activities in compliance with company requirements, health and safety standards, and applicable airport procedures and regulations. Cost: Maintains awareness of the Line Maintenance International expenditure budget and ensures the cost-effective utilization of manpower, time, and materials. Service: Establishes and effectively maintains aircraft exterior and interior cabin standards in line with the expectations of a leading world-class airline. Operational Performance: Maintains awareness of On-Time Performance (OTP) targets set by the VPTO while ensuring the safety of operations by maintaining the airworthiness of assigned aircraft to the highest standards. Innovation: Utilizes the latest technologies to support effective and efficient solutions. Strategy: Maintains full awareness of Etihad OGSM and the Line and Cabin Maintenance operational strategy. Staff Performance: Ensures that competency, capability, development, and training requirements are appropriately actioned and maintained through the effective and timely use of i-Achieve, CPM, i-Learn, Etihad Policies and Procedures, and other appropriate tools. Essential: High School Leaving Certificate or university/college qualification. Holder of GCAA license or convertible to GCAA License. Authorization on two Etihad aircraft types (Level 3) Essential: A minimum of 10 years of aircraft maintenance experience, of which at least three years must have been within a Line Maintenance environment. Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight. To learn more visit www.etihad.com Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer.
